title: Video Editing Services in Houston
metaTitle: Video Editing Services in Houston, TX | TDM
metaDescription: Video editing for Houston companies: ad cuts, reels, product and brand videos from your footage, captioned and exported for every platform. Edited remotely.
lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) edits video for Houston businesses: ad cuts, reels, product videos, brand films and YouTube content. You send the footage and our editors handle the cut, pacing, colour, sound, captions, motion graphics and export. Editing is done at TDM's production hub in Lahore, not in Houston, and files are exchanged online. Much Houston footage is technical or shot on working sites, so we pay particular attention to accuracy and to what may and may not be shown.

sections.heading: The footage Houston companies already have
paragraphs: Most businesses here are sitting on more video than they use. An equipment maker has phone clips from the shop floor and a factory acceptance test. A contractor has drone passes over a job site. A surgeon has a recorded talk and a few patient-education explanations. A restaurant group has months of kitchen clips from staff phones.

Editing turns that material into something a buyer will watch. A long capability video becomes a short overview for the home page, several clips for LinkedIn and a muted, captioned version for a trade show screen. We start by reviewing what you have and telling you plainly what it can support.

sections.heading: Editing technical and regulated material
paragraphs: Industrial video has to be right. A caption that names the wrong component, or a cut that shows a step out of order, costs credibility with an engineer in seconds. We ask for a short glossary and a named reviewer on your side, and on-screen text is approved before final export.

Clearance matters as much as accuracy. Footage filmed at a customer's plant may show their logos, equipment tags or staff badges. Clinic footage may show patients or screens. Tell us what is cleared for publication and we blur, crop or cut the rest.
bullets: Hook-first ad cuts for Meta, TikTok and YouTube, with several openings per concept for testing.
Vertical reels and short clips paced for feeds, delivered in batches.
Longer product, capability and brand videos, colour-graded and sound-designed.
Burned-in captions, animated text, logo stings and end cards for viewers watching on mute.
Every master exported in 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 and 16:9 as each placement requires.

sections.heading: How remote editing works from Houston
paragraphs: You upload raw files to a shared folder. We agree the platforms, lengths and messages each edit must serve, then deliver a first batch for review instead of one video at a time. You leave timestamped comments and we revise. Because our editors are many hours ahead of Central Time, work often moves forward overnight relative to your working day.
For clients whose advertising we also manage, editors see how each cut performs in the ad account and re-cut weak openings, lengths and calls to action based on those numbers.

sections.heading: What to check when choosing an editor
paragraphs: Ask how many revision rounds are included and how feedback is given. Ask which formats and lengths you will receive, and whether captioned and clean versions are both supplied. Ask who checks technical wording. And ask whether the editor will ever see performance data, or will simply deliver files and move on.

presence: TDM works with Houston businesses remotely. We have no office, studio or editor in the city. Editing is carried out at our production hub in Lahore, and footage, review links and final files are shared online.

faqs.q: Is there a TDM editing studio in Houston?
faqs.a: No. Our editors work from TDM's production hub in Lahore. Houston clients upload footage, review cuts through shared links and receive finished files online.

faqs.q: Can you edit footage we filmed ourselves on a phone or drone?
faqs.a: Yes. Many clients send phone footage, drone clips, archive material or recordings from events. We review it, tell you what it can support, and point out any gaps that a short extra shot would fix.

faqs.q: How much does video editing cost for a Houston business?
faqs.a: It depends on the scope: the amount of footage, the number of finished videos and the formats required. We quote after a free consultation.

faqs.q: How do you handle confidential footage from a plant or client site?
faqs.a: Tell us what has been cleared for publication. We blur or remove logos, tags, badges, screens and anything else you flag, and on-screen text is approved by your reviewer before final export. Permission from the site owner remains your responsibility to obtain.

faqs.q: How fast can edits be turned around?
faqs.a: It depends on the brief and the volume of footage, and the schedule is agreed in the plan.
